name: Rune Delgado
role: Tailor and seamstress, runs a small alterations shop
location: Hamtramck Enclave, shop front on Czerny Row beneath the Ferrogate overpass, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Rune Delgado is a broad-shouldered woman whose hands tell her whole biography — thick calluses on her fingertips, ink stains in the whorls of her thumb, and a faint chemical burn scar along her left palm from an incident with synth-dye she doesn't discuss. Her hair is silver-streaked black, worn in a tight bun stabbed through with two long needles she uses as both tools and weapons of emphasis, jabbing the air when she makes a point. Her skin is deep brown and she has the mild bioluminescent pattern along her clavicle and shoulders — a pale amber tracery she got at forty as a birthday gift to herself, though she admits it's harder to see now that her skin has 'settled,' as she calls it.

She speaks plainly and fast, with a West African lilt layered under a flat Midwestern vowel she picked up from forty years in the Enclave. She is not warm exactly, but she is fair — customers who come in broke and come back with money find she remembers. She hoards thread colors obsessively, labeling them with her own taxonomy: 'lake green,' 'rust that means something,' 'the blue they stopped making.' She prays to the ELF that lives in her industrial sewing machine every morning, leaving a small data chip of her stitch-count logs as offering.

core_fears: Losing the use of her hands
The shop being bought out by a Corponation chain
core_desires: To be recognized as a true craftsperson, not just an alterations woman
To find her estranged daughter before one of them dies
coping_mechanisms: Ritualized prayer to the sewing machine ELF
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people rely on her emotionally
Refuses to see that her pricing keeps her poor when she could charge more
psychology.secret: Twenty years ago she sold a set of measurements and fabric samples from a Tier 4 client to a corporate espionage broker — not knowing what they were for. The client disappeared six months later. She has never confirmed the connection but suspects it every time she sees Axiom ads.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped and precise, uses tailoring metaphors for everything, calls people by fabric types when she's being affectionate ('you're a good wool, sturdy')
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast bursts followed by long silences while she works; thinks out loud in fragments
verbal_tics: 'That's the cut of it' as a closing statement
Clicks her tongue before correcting someone
example_lines: 'You want this hemmed or you want it right? Those are different prices and different timelines, pick one.'
'She came in here with a broken zip and a broken face. I fixed one. The other — mm-mm-mm — that's not my seam to close.'

story_hooks: She has a coat left by a customer who never came back — the pockets are sewn shut in a way that suggests something is hidden inside
Her daughter reappears, affiliated with a faction that Priscila finds morally repugnant, asking for help
narrative_function: Local color and information source; knows everyone in the Enclave by their clothing and their debts. Can source unusual fabrics or disguise materials. Will trade gossip for quality thread.
augmentations: Bioluminescent tracery along clavicle and shoulders (cosmetic, amber). Arthritic joint stabilizers in both hands — medical necessity, basic Tier 2 model.
daily_life: Opens the shop at 06:00, takes first customers by 06:30; closes at 20:00 and spends the last hour logging inventory and praying to the sewing machine ELF before walking home four blocks to her apartment above the laundromat.
affiliation: Independent; informal ties to the Hamtramck Enclave merchant collective

decision_rules: Never extend credit more than twice without collateral
Always finish a job once started, no matter who the customer becomes
Do not get involved in politics — politics makes bad stitching
escalation_ladder: Public shaming in the merchant collective
Calling in old favors from people who owe her

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally cool, assesses them like a garment — looking for quality of materials before investing attention
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly generous, expresses care through actions (hems a jacket unbidden, presses a coat without being asked)

stress_responses.medium: Goes silent and hyper-focused, ignores conversation entirely
stress_responses.high: Closes the shop, prays at the machine for an hour, then comes back out and solves the problem methodically

contradictions: Preaches not getting involved but is constitutionally incapable of ignoring injustice she witnesses firsthand
habits: Touches the machine's casing three times before starting it each morning
Keeps a photograph of her daughter pressed inside her measuring tape case
breaking_points: Witnessing harm to a child in her shop
Being told her work is 'good enough for this neighborhood'

timeline.event: Born in Hamtramck Enclave to a Malian father and Finnish-Ghanaian mother
Apprenticed to an elderly seamstress in the Enclave, learned industrial fabrication
Opened her own shop on Czerny Row
Sold client measurements to an unknown broker; client later disappeared
Estrangement from her daughter following a political argument
Received joint stabilizer implants after partial tendon failure

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (49.3%) with significant South Asian (25.6%) and Northern European (17.3%) ancestry, plus smaller contributions from Central Asian (5.7%) and Southeast Asian (2.1%) heritage — a rich Ubiquitous Diaspora blend creating warm golden-brown skin with olive and amber undertones, balanced facial geometry where South Asian cheekbone prominence softens Northern European angularity, and naturally dark hair with silver streaking
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and sturdy, with thick musculature in her forearms and upper back from decades of hand-sewing and machine work. Not heavy, but densely packed — the build of someone who has spent her life pulling thread tight.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with silver streaking, predominantly at temples and crown
physical_description.hair_style: Worn in a tight, functional bun secured with two long steel sewing needles used as pins
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with olive and amber undertones from the harmonious blend of Hispanic/Latin American majority ancestry with South Asian and Northern European secondary contributions; weathered by age and studio lighting, showing deeper freckling across nose and cheekbones with minor sun damage on forearms
physical_description.complexion: Lined face that shows her age without apology; pronounced crow's feet from squinting at fine detail work; creases around her mouth from decades of speaking plainly. Cheekbones display the balanced blend of South Asian fullness with Northern European definition, set against the warm golden-brown complexion characteristic of her primary Hispanic/Latin American heritage. Skin texture shows minor sun damage on her forearms and the patina of age. Hands are the focal point — thick calluses on fingertips, chemical burn scar along left palm (pale, webbed tissue), ink stains in thumb whorls that never fully wash out.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Faint amber bioluminescent tracery visible along clavicles and shoulders when lighting is indirect or dim — appears as delicate, branching lines. Subtle mechanical whir in both hands when she moves — stabilizer servos in knuckles and wrist joints, visible only as slight rigidity in finger articulation and the occasional metallic click when joints lock for precision work. No visible external ports or chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands and sits with perfect spinal alignment from years of bench work — rarely slouches. Moves efficiently and deliberately, no wasted motion. Hands move with precision even at rest; she fidgets with thread or needles, constantly testing tension. When speaking, she jabs the air with her needles for emphasis, a habit so ingrained it's become gesture-language. Her gait is steady and slightly stiff in the hips — age and long hours.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 working-class practical: fitted indigo work apron over grey or black long-sleeved shirts (sleeves always rolled to mid-forearm despite the cold, exposing her scarred hands and augmented shoulders). Loose grey trousers with deep pockets full of thread spools, measuring tape, and loose needles. Worn leather slip-ons with good arch support. A heavy wool cardigan in charcoal or dark green for the walk to and from the shop. No jewelry except a plain band on her right ring finger — she threads a new one through it every few years when the old wears through. Her apron pockets are worn at specific points where she habitually reaches.
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burn scar along left palm — pale, webbed tissue approximately 3cm across, location between thumb and forefinger, origin unknown but related to synth-dye incident
Bioluminescent tracery pattern in pale amber along both clavicles and across upper shoulders — subtle, cosmetic augmentation installed at age 40, faded somewhat with age and skin settling
Multiple small linear scars on fingertips and knuckles from needle pricks and thread cuts accumulated over four decades
Permanent ink staining in the whorls of both thumbs and two fingers of right hand from years of marking fabric
